headline: Remove native APK self-installer; use browser-only manual GitHub updates

changes.title: Remove in-app APK installer and network permissions
changes.detail: The Android and Fire OS app no longer downloads or installs APKs, requests package installation permission or internet permission, or schedules update checks. Unused installer service, FileProvider and library code were removed.

changes.title: Open GitHub Releases when players request the latest version
changes.detail: The Game Updates button opens GitHub Releases in the external browser for manual APK download and standard Android installation. The release list includes prereleases; the application does not handle the downloaded APK.

changes.title: Keep the existing signed Android and Fire OS upgrade identity
changes.detail: Keep the pinned publisher certificate, versionCode and remote release SHA-256 readback while retiring the obsolete update manifest. The built APK is checked for forbidden installer and native network permissions.
